items.assessment: One canonical SWAP kernel remains authoritative; F-TB06 changes tests only.
No kernel I/O or adapter semantics changed.
Thermal parameters, forcing, committed state, scratch and results remain explicitly separated.
Thermal persistent state exists only for active columns; inactive columns remain compact.
Thermal workspace remains model/worker-local scratch and is not persisted.
Mixed active/inactive MultiSWAP isolation is preserved without changing storage layout.
Water plus thermal commit, rejection and rollback remain one outer transaction.
Retry is checked from the identical committed physical origin.
Thermal and restart cases use generic numeric intervals without calendar dependence.
No coupling-window semantics changed.
Coupling architecture is untouched and prior transaction semantics are replayed.
Groundwater interface contract is unchanged.
Hard water mass remains required; thermal energy is separately accounted and never inserted into water mass.
Interface-sensitivity outputs are untouched.
No production coupling-cost path changes.
Serialized mixed MultiSWAP thermal-active/inactive isolation is permanently registered; no unsupported parallel thermal claim is made.
No MODFLOW cell-to-column mapping semantics changed.
Deep-vadose remains outside SWAP and outside this workunit.
No cross-component storage transfer semantics changed.
Alternative soil-water solver interface remains untouched.
F-VQ58 remains the separate soil-temperature scientific authority; runtime adoption reuses it unchanged.
Thermal runtime continues to consume the process hydraulic view rather than HeadCalc internals.
Thermal process activation remains physics configuration, separate from numerical policy.
No bounded-cost or fallback policy is changed; retry semantics are preserved.
Reference scientific authority F-VQ58 remains independently replayable.
Transaction, restart, determinism and process qualification markers remain observable in CI.
Inactive columns allocate no thermal persistent state; optional functionality scales with use.
Runtime composition remains external to SWAP kernel ownership; no system-composition relation is added.
Registered thermal cases explicitly use generic time and immutable authorities; no hidden midnight/file/MODFLOW dependency is introduced.
This audit plus exact-head CI explicitly qualify the architecture change.

hard_nonclaims: no snow plus soil-temperature combined profile
no new combined water-plus-thermal timestep acceptance policy
